IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'TRY_SDI' and table_schema = 'EDS' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE')

BEGIN
   DROP VIEW EDS.TRY_SDI;
END;


CREATE TABLE EDS.TRY_SDI
WITH
(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=HASH(BENEFICIARY_ID)
)
AS
SELECT Beneficiary
	, Beneficiary_Id
	, CBCGLAcctEncryted
	, CBCGLAcctSixDigits
	, Currencies
	, Direct
	, Id
	, Method
	, Pay_Receive
	, ProcessingOrg
	, Products
	, Roles

	, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm

FROM
(
	SELECT Beneficiary
		, Beneficiary_Id
		, CBCGLAcctEncryted
		, CBCGLAcctSixDigits
		, Currencies
		, Direct
		, Id
		, Method
		, Pay_Receive
		, ProcessingOrg
		, Products
		, Roles
		, isActive
		, isLatest
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, insert_dttm

		, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY Id
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  				
	FROM
	(
		SELECT Beneficiary
			, Beneficiary_Id
			, CBCGLAcctEncryted
			, CBCGLAcctSixDigits
			, Currencies
			, Direct
			, Id
			, Method
			, Pay_Receive
			, ProcessingOrg
			, Products
			, Roles
			, isActive
			, isLatest
			, BNK_CODE
			, SOURCE_CODE
			, FILE_NAME
			, insert_dttm

			, row_number() 
				over( partition by Beneficiary
						, Beneficiary_Id
						, CBCGLAcctEncryted
						, CBCGLAcctSixDigits
						, Currencies
						, Direct
						, Id
						, Method
						, Pay_Receive
						, ProcessingOrg
						, Products
						, Roles
						, isActive
						, isLatest
						, BNK_CODE
						, SOURCE_CODE
						, FILE_NAME

					order by insert_dttm DESC) AS SEQ_NO
		FROM BUSC.TRY_SDI

	) AS TMP
	WHERE SEQ_NO = 1
) AS SCDT2
LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
	ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;

(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=HASH(ACCOUNTCODE)
)
AS

	, ACCOUNTNAME
	, ACCOUNTCODE
	, ACCOUNTTYPE
	, STATUS
	, EMAIL
	, MOBILE
	, SETA
	, MOTHERSMAIDENNAME
	, ERRORMESSAGE
	, LAST6_ACCT_NUM

	, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm

FROM
(
	SELECT ONLINEID
		, ACCOUNTNAME
		, ACCOUNTCODE
		, ACCOUNTTYPE
		, STATUS
		, EMAIL
		, MOBILE
		, SETA
		, MOTHERSMAIDENNAME

		, ISLATEST
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, INSERT_DTTM

		, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY ACCOUNTCODE
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE

CREATE TABLE EDS.SEC_ACCTLINK
WITH
(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=HASH(CLTCODE)
)
AS
SELECT ACCTKEY
	, CLTCODE
	, LINKCODE

	, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm

FROM
(
	SELECT ACCTKEY
		, CLTCODE
		, LINKCODE
		, isActive
		, isLatest
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, insert_dttm

		, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY CLTCODE, ACCTKEY
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  				
	FROM
	(
		SELECT ACCTKEY
			, CLTCODE
			, LINKCODE
			, isActive
			, isLatest

			, SOURCE_CODE
			, FILE_NAME
			, insert_dttm

						, FILE_NAME

	ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;
